name: Qwen3.8-27B SGLang DSPARK（单节点）
description: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 单节点 SGLang 服务：lmsysorg/sglang 镜像、flashinfer 注意力、DSPARK 投机解码（mamba 草稿模型）、FP8 KV、--mamba-full-memory-ratio 11.01（疑似笔误，待验证）。
compose_template:
services:
  sglang-qwen:
    image: ${SGLANG_IMAGE:-lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-qwen38
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${SGLANG_PORT:-30000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    volumes:
      # 与源 docker run 一致：宿主 HF 缓存挂到 /root/.cache/huggingface（SGLang 默认 HF_HOME）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /root/.cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      HF_TOKEN: "${HF_TOKEN:-}"  # 受 gating 的模型需 token；从 HF 缓存加载可留空
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        exec sglang serve ${SGLANG_MODEL:-RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4}
        --trust-remote-code
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
        --mem-fraction-static ${MEM_FRACTION_STATIC:-0.85}
        --attention-backend flashinfer
        --chunked-prefill-size ${CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE:-2048}
        --reasoning-parser qwen3
        --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder
        --mamba-full-memory-ratio ${MAMBA_FULL_MEMORY_RATIO:-11.01}
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${SGLANG_PORT:-30000}
        --speculative-algorithm DSPARK
        --speculative-draft-model-path ${SGLANG_DRAFT_MODEL:-RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark}
        --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer
        --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer_lazy
        --mamba-ssm-dtype float32

variables.label: SGLang 镜像
variables.help: 从已拉取镜像中选择（控制平面先拉取再分发）
variables.help_en: Pick from pulled images (control plane pulls then distributes)

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: 从已下载模型中选择（控制平面下载后分发到各节点缓存）
variables.help_en: Pick from downloaded models (control plane downloads and distributes)

variables.label: DSpark 草稿模型
variables.help: DSpark 投机解码的 mamba 草稿模型路径（需已分发到节点）
variables.help_en: Mamba draft model path for DSpark speculative decoding (must be distributed)

variables.label: Mamba 全显存比例
variables.help: 源命令 11.01 疑似笔误（比例应 ≤1），很可能是 0.1101 或 0.11；发布前核实
variables.help_en: Source 11.01 is likely a typo (a ratio must be ≤1); probably 0.1101 or 0.11 — verify before publishing

variables.label: HuggingFace Token
variables.help: 受 gating 的模型授权 token；模型已由管理平台分发到缓存时通常可留空
variables.help_en: Auth token for gated models; usually empty when the model is pre-distributed to the cache

description_en: Single-node SGLang serving for Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4: lmsysorg/sglang image, flashinfer attention, DSPARK speculation (mamba draft model), FP8 KV, --mamba-full-memory-ratio 11.01 (suspected typo, to verify).
